verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt at documentation.mailgun.com (HTTP 200), described as a map of all Mailgun documentation files, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The docs are also served as .md pages, which agents can fetch. Missing for 10: evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt), and first-party guidance on pointing agents at the docs or independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: LLMS.txt containing a map of all the documentation files for Mailgun.
